scientific_integrity: Proof establishes the infinite-dimensional Gaussian inner product, exact finite Gram determinant and a fully quantified shape limit analytically; the attached numerical and symbolic tests are supplementary. Published antecedents and unresolved historical-priority uncertainty are identified without claiming external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact determinant for Gaussian four-corner Weyl shifts and sharp small-area determinant asymptotic only. No all-area optimal design, arbitrary quadrilateral theorem, smallest-eigenvalue optimization, or infinite Gabor lattice frame bound. The earliest motivating source date follows the public arXiv metadata, rather than the arXiv numerical identifier. Independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Sharp small-cell shape asymmetry for four Gaussian Gabor atoms
